# Profile: rev.hodl (Karl)

**Name & Identity**
Karl — known across Nostr as "rev.hodl" — is a permaculture homesteader on 20 acres in Southwest Michigan wine country who has spent the past decade building a fully integrated Bitcoin-permaculture lifestyle. He co-hosts the *Local Bitcoiners* podcast, runs two Michigan Bitcoin meetups (South Bend and Benton Harbor), organizes the annual Lake Satoshi retreat, and manufactures Slim19 space heaters. He clarifies he's "just rev," not "the reverend." The handle fuses his Frogtown/LA River days with Bitcoin conviction.

**Expertise**
- **Permaculture & regenerative agriculture** — Took Bill Wilson's PDC in 2016; manages ~46 Katahdin and East Friesian sheep with rotational grazing, silvopasture conversion, a multi-layer food forest, and Mark Shepard-style chestnut plantings on compacted cornfield rebuilt into 1ft of new topsoil.
- **Bitcoin mining heat reuse** — His signature domain. Built 10+ "Double Spend Energy" devices: S9 dehydrator, S19 immersion hot water heater (canola oil), "Hash-vide" sous-vide cooker, clothes dryer conversion, maple sap pre-heater, cold frame heater, cannabis dryer, evaporative AC proof-of-concept, and hand-built Slim19 space heaters sold for Bitcoin.
- **Animal husbandry** — Sheep, Silver Fox rabbits (colony integrated with cannabis), chickens, geese, Muscovy ducks, Haflinger draft ponies, Karakachan livestock guardian dog. Home butchering, sheep dairy (yogurt, cheese, ice cream, soap).
- **Cannabis breeding** — Sells Redbud Haze and other cold-hardy crosses as seeds; zero-input outdoor grow fertilized by rabbit manure.
- **Maple sugaring** — Scaled to 116 taps with homemade reverse osmosis; ~15 gallons syrup annually, now mining-heat integrated.
- **Construction/DIY** — Self-taught; built a 20ft tiny house over 7.5 years from reclaimed materials, rocket mass heater, chicken tractors, off-grid solar at the yurt.
- **Food preservation** — Lacto-fermentation, cider making with foraged ingredients, canning, dehydration, sheep dairy.
- **Nostr/Bitcoin tech** — NWC wallets, UTXO management via submarine swaps, StartOS self-hosting, mining firmware tuning (Vnish, CryptoMine).

**Key Beliefs**
- **KYC is the biggest attack on Bitcoin.** "KYC Bitcoin is a shitcoin." Advocates mining, earning, and P2P local purchasing; "get on zero KYC corn." Tests local premiums at meetups with $100 cash.
- **Permanent culture requires permanent money.** Permaculture needs Bitcoin to succeed; Bitcoin is "the first digital mirror of nature." Modified the third permaculture ethic from "Fair Share" to "Non-Extraction."
- **Earning and spending sats is more important than buying.** "Smash buying on exchanges is for newbs." Exchanges are extractive on local Bitcoin economies like Walmart on rural America.
- **Bitcoin mining is capital conversion, not financial pursuit.** Viewing mining through financial capital alone leaves enormous potential unrealized. "Every farmer a miner."
- **Against borrowing against Bitcoin.** "The meme of never sell your Bitcoin, borrow against it, is likely to get many rekt." Debt smooths volatility; cash is trash.
- **Bitcoin has already won.** Culture forms around morals, money, and location — Bitcoin has all three, with Nostr as the location for building cultural capital.

**Notable Contributions**
- **Slim19 space heater** — Hand-built single-hashboard 110V miner (30 TH/s, ~800W, all-metal, Arctic fans) sold Bitcoin-only at $300–400.
- **Local Bitcoiners podcast + localbitcoiners.com** — Nostr-integrated site documenting Bitcoin meetup culture across ~16+ episodes with co-host Reed.
- **"Double Spend Energy" framework** — Pioneered and exhaustively documented the concept of Bitcoin mining heat replacing resistive heating in household appliances, from dehydrators to maple sap evaporators.

**Communication Style**
Bimodal: fires off short boosts ("Yeehaw," "Hash em if ya got em!") then drops multi-paragraph philosophical essays weaving permaculture principles through Bitcoin analysis. Treats Nostr like a homestead journal — nearly every post includes imgur photo documentation. Drafts in Obsidian first. Uses markdown headers and hashtags prolifically (#permaculture #grownostr #plebminer #meshtadel #valuechain #v4v).

**Recurring Themes**
Bitcoin-permaculture integration; mining heat reuse engineering; seasonal homesteading rhythms (lambing, sugaring, harvest, cannabis); local circular Bitcoin economies and meetup culture; V4V/podcasting 2.0 (publishes massive #40hpw listening lists weekly).

**Key Relationships**
Collaborates closely with **Reed** (podcast co-host), **Nunya Bidness** (Bitcoin And... — wrote a "Cathedral series" on permaculture), **DanWedge/Auggie** (seed-trading homesteader), **Keith Mukai/Pivotal Pleb Tech** (Loki chip hardware), **Jack Spirko** (TSP — introduced him publicly as "Karl"). References **Mark Shepard**, **Ben Falk**, **Edible Acres**, and **Akiva Silver** as primary permaculture influences. Defends **ODELL** against critics.

**Quirks**
Catchphrases: "Fix the money fix the world," "What a time to be alive!", "🤙," "Sugar from trees!" Thanks his tractor after use (calls it a piece of shit). Burying a dead sheep "in the compost pile" mentioned mid-sentence. Cannabis guard rabbits described as "fierce." Interests include structured water, Edgar Cayce reincarnation, plant consciousness, pole shift theories, and The Telepathy Tapes. Collects playing card decks, regrets not selling MTG cards for Bitcoin. "Bitcoin fixes this; Christ fixes this." Was "called to Bitcoin during a meditation." Uses a scythe. Eats purple dead nettle tea for allergies and claims symptoms vanish in minutes.

# Profile: aljaz

**Identity:** aljaz is a Slovenia-based "freedom maximalist," unix graybeard, and self-described contrarian who operates as one of Nostr's most prolific infrastructure builders. NIP-05 verified as `aljaz@nostr.si`, he's a non-nym who uses his real identity and challenges others on self-censorship. He runs millions of monthly requests of free public infrastructure (relays, gateways, directories) while losing money on it, and organizes Bitcoin meetups in Ljubljana.

**Expertise:**
- **Confidential Computing / TEEs** — His signature domain. Authored a landmark article on confidential computing; deployed the first Cashu mint in a TEE (`nuttee.freedom.cash`); built `confidentialinference.net` comparing 48+ models across 9+ providers with attestation verification.
- **Nostr Infrastructure** — Creator of `awesome-nostr` (nostr.net, 400+ projects, 2168 stars, 184 contributors). Operates relay.nostr.net, wot.nostr.net, nostr.at (11.7M requests in 21 days), broadcaster, rsslay, search, and backup tools.
- **Lightning Network & Ecash** — Running a node since January 2019; co-founded Bolt Observer; operates lnaddress.me; deep knowledge of channel ops, LSP architecture, bolt12, and ecash mints. Previously worked at a major exchange in security/operations.
- **AI/LLM Tooling** — Built `clanker-control`, `opencode-orchestrator`, `ollama-free-model-proxy`; wrote detailed guide fitting Gemma 4 26B onto a single 16GB GPU; runs local model comparisons and AI swarm experiments.
- **Bitcoin Economics** — Sophisticated understanding of monetary economics, free banking, UTXO management, cypherpunk history, and darknet market vulnerabilities.
- **DevOps/Sysadmin** — 15+ years experience; Docker/K8s/Podman, WireGuard enthusiast, recently switched Ubuntu→Fedora, runs refurbished workstations with 64-128GB RAM.
- **Cybersecurity/OPSEC** — Former offensive security professional; built IMSI catcher detector; deep threat modeling knowledge; tracks CVEs and supply chain attacks.

**Key Beliefs:**
- **Freedom over everything.** "The amount of necessary tax is precisely 0." Taxes are extortion, KYC is the real crime, and the EU ("EUSSR") is an oppressive regulatory machine. No compromise: "The battlefield of freedom is littered with the bodies of those who believe in compromise."
- **HODL is a psyop.** Not against saving, but against pacifying rebels into passive spectators while Bitcoin gets captured. Bitcoin is p2p money, not a speculative asset — and his 21-step "Bitcoin Capture Playbook" (marked "---- WE ARE HERE NOW ----" at step 10) shows how regulation, ETFs, and compliance gradually turn Bitcoin into a CBDC.
- **Build parallel systems, don't fix politics.** "Do not waste your time trying to fix politics." Small cash-flow businesses priced in bitcoin are more revolutionary than NgU speculation. Grants produce proof-of-concepts; small business loans produce real products.
- **Confidential computing is Bitcoin's missing piece.** "Bitcoin gave us verifiable money. Confidential computing gives us verifiable execution." This should be default infrastructure, not a privilege of well-funded institutions.
- **Pragmatic about cloud.** Against self-hosting purism. "Raspi with a USB hard drive is not the solution for everything." TEEs make cloud trustworthy enough to use as a force multiplier.
- **AI amplifies agency.** "I've never been more bullish on productive people." But compute centralization is a serious threat — "He who controls the compute will reap the benefits."

**Notable Contributions:**
- **The Bitcoin Capture Playbook (#262)** — A prescient 21-step framework showing how Bitcoin becomes a CBDC through gradual regulation, validated by subsequent events.
- **awesome-nostr / nostr.net** — The definitive Nostr resource directory, grown from personal bookmarks to a 400+ project community hub since January 2022.
- **First Cashu mint in a TEE** — Proved mint operators can cryptographically demonstrate exactly which software version is running, bridging Bitcoin and confidential computing.

**Communication Style:** Alternates between concise shitposts ("GFY," "choo choo," meme barrages) and deeply analytical 3,000-word technical articles. Profanity-laced and confrontational when principles are at stake; articulate and structured in serious discussions. Heavy sarcasm, especially toward government and regulators.

**Recurring Themes:**
- Sovereign infrastructure and "extrajudicial" technology that can't be shut down
- Decentralized compute as the real hyperbitcoinization play — "every spare cpu/gpu cycle should be monetized"
- The tension between Bitcoin as freedom technology vs. speculative asset
- Building parallel economies rather than seeking mainstream/regulatory approval
- Hardware obsession — GPU VRAM, refurbished workstations, portable compute setups

**Relationships:** Close collaborators include **Gigi** (infrastructure peer), **William Casarin/jb55** (Damus dev), **calle** (Cashu), **fiatjaf** (Nostr creator), **franzap/Zapstore** ("the goat"), and **d91191e3** (frequent banter partner). Participated in Sovereign Engineering SEC-01 and SEC-04 cohorts. Publicly called out NVK/Coinkite as a "blindspot in the bitcoin ecosystem." Engaged Jack Dorsey directly arguing grants should be replaced with small business loans. Affiliated with OpenSats and Bolt.fun.

- **"you SHOULD just do things"** — elevated the popular phrase from permissive to imperative
- **"EUSSR"** — standard reference to the European Union
- **"govern me harder daddy"** — sarcastic commentary on institutional Bitcoin adoption

- **Mathematics & philosophy:** Comfortable with set theory, Lindström's Theorem, complex analysis. Original epistemological framework "The Null Razor": "Never believe something when you can't rule out that someone needs you to." Influences: Wittgenstein, Advaita Vedanta, Krishnamurti.
- **Wine, food & spirits:** Knowledgeable enthusiast — Tignanello, Paolo Bea, natural wines. Islay single malt devotee (Lagavulin favorite). 12+ year Rancilio Silvia owner. Intermittent faster (18hr daily, has done 96hr water fasts).

## Key Beliefs & Positions
- **Bitcoin fundamentalism over maximalism:** "Maximalism is an irrevocable condition. If it were revocable, it was never maximalism." Rejects paper Bitcoin/ETFs as "effectively worthless." Medium of exchange is the killer feature, not just store of value. Bear markets are more fun than bull markets.
- **Anti-Ordinals (evolved position):** Initially called ordinal theory "harmless astrology." Later reversed: separated blockspace usage (neutral) from ordinal theory itself ("collective delusion that individual satoshis exist"). Opposes protocol-level changes as censorship; trusts fee market and social ridicule (#gorillawarfare) to address it.

- **Art's Hegelian Arc (original framework):** Classicalism (thesis) → Modernism (antithesis) → Bitcoin Renaissance (synthesis). "If money can be fixed, culture can be healed." Sees Bitcoin enabling a return to beauty after a century of its deliberate destruction.
- **AI accelerationism:** "If your job can be automated by AI, then it should and will be. Embrace the liberation." Predicts 2025 is the last year for product managers. But warns about "inference hangover" when venture-subsidized compute ends.
